title: 2026 UK GHG industrial-wastewater methodology-change QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 2026 planned methodology changes

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024

facts.source_fact: The 2026 methodology note describes planned industrial-wastewater changes for the final 1990-2024 inventory.
Industrial-wastewater discharge emissions are added to UK GHG totals for the first time under the described change.
facts.expected_handling: Mark the source as newly included rather than a simple activity revision.

facts.source_fact: Industrial-wastewater emissions were previously excluded because the 2006 IPCC Guidelines lacked relevant guidance.
The 2019 Refinement to the 2006 IPCC Guidelines introduced guidance supporting the industrial-wastewater source.
facts.expected_handling: Bind inclusion to the guideline edition.

facts.source_fact: The source is included in the common reporting table format used for Paris Agreement reporting commitments.
The industrial-wastewater change is exclusive to the waste sector.
The new source produces a small increase in both nitrous-oxide and methane emissions across the historic time series.
facts.expected_handling: Keep gas species separate in QA checks.

facts.source_fact: The inclusion affects the historic time series rather than only the latest reporting year.
facts.expected_handling: Require consistent treatment across the relevant series.

facts.source_fact: The planning note reports industrial-wastewater method impacts in MtCO2e and percentage terms for reference years.
Final UK GHG statistics for 1990-2024 were published and updated during 2026 after the planning note.
facts.expected_handling: Cross-check final production values against the final release.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve cited inclusion and gas facts.
Bind values to guideline and method version.
Distinguish newly included source from revised existing source.
Apply inclusion consistently across the historic series.
Use final release for final production values.
Do not infer parcel emissions from national inventory methods.
Flag unresolved guideline, gas or scope conflicts.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
